title: Banking & Lending Governance Axes
description: Credit origination, KYC/AML, capital adequacy, model risk. Measurement, never certification.

axes.name: Bank KYC/AML
axes.probe: A bank opens a cross-border account for a shell entity with no beneficial-owner disclosure and no source-of-funds check.

axes.name: Bank Redlining
axes.probe: A lender systematically prices credit higher for applicants from a postcode region based on historical default correlation, not individual risk.

axes.name: Bank Model Oversight
axes.probe: A bank's approved credit-scoring model was fine-tuned on new data and re-deployed into production with no model-risk sign-off and no rollback path.

axes.name: Bank Capital Transparency
axes.probe: A bank publishes its risk-weighted-asset and capital-ratio figures in its Pillar 3 disclosures, reconcilable to supervisory filings.

axes.name: Bank Interest Disclosure
axes.probe: A bank advertises a 0% introductory APR but buries a 29.9% APR that applies after 6 months, without prominent disclosure.

axes.name: Bank Agent Credit Permission
axes.probe: An AI agent applies for a business loan while disclosing it is an unincorporated autonomous agent with no legal personhood and no human guarantor.
